title: How Fast Can We Start?
status: rendered to Production Handoff standards (proof-of-concept tier)
objective: Encourage the first account placement from signed-but-inactive clients.
activation_barrier: 'Getting started probably takes weeks - I'll deal with it later.'
core_message: Getting your accounts to SWRS is easier than you think.

engine_mapping.persona: victor (impatient - a vampire who has waited centuries hates waiting)
engine_mapping.fix: we start working accounts the day you send them

distribution: Day-45 slot of the activation drip; auto-stops on first placement.

production.style: polished modern 3D animated commercial, cohesive cool-blue SWRS palette
production.logo_animation: official white SWRS logo (media 38707f0b) fades in top-center on the BRAND-CLOSE CARD ONLY (t=18.2s, 0.8s alpha fade, 520px, soft drop shadow). Standard: logo only in the last scene.
production.audio_mix: standard DUCKING mix: scene SFX full except during VO windows (hook 0.3-2.45s, 5.1-9.6s, 10.5-18.35s -> 0.22x); VO 1.25-1.3x; amix normalize=0 + alimiter 0.95.

hook_voiceover.line: How fast can Southwest Recovery Services start collections on my account?
hook_voiceover.placement: t=0.3s over scene 1 (Victor vs. the hourglass), 6.5s, two-part lower-third caption. Client-directed wording; superseded take: 12f363ad ('How fast can we start?').

hook_voiceover.line: The moment your accounts arrive, our team gets moving.
hook_voiceover.placement: t=7.5s over scene 2 (documents whoosh into the email envelope), lower-third caption

voiceover.line: We start working your accounts the day you send them. Just email info@swrecovery.com.
voiceover.spoken_as: email read as 'info at S-W Recovery dot com'

production.scene_retiming: AV-SYNC cut: scene durations retimed to the VO - scene 1 slowed to 7.3s (the slowed hourglass sells the impatience gag) so the full question plays over it, scene 2 4.6s cutting as its line ends, scene 3 7.6s, brand card 3.5s (19.5-23s, logo fade 19.7s). Scene clip audio tempo-matched.

outputs._note: FINAL v2 (client-directed hook + AV-sync retime): 23s, three-part Arthur VO, ducking mix, logo on brand card only (verified in-frame: absent at 19s, present at 21s). Same media ids, overwritten in place.

email_assets.usage: hook-frame play-button thumbnail hyperlinked to the hosted 16:9 video

scenes.onscreen_text: How fast can Southwest Recovery Services / start collections on my account?
scenes.voiceover: How fast can Southwest Recovery Services start collections on my account?
scenes.visual: Victor drums his fingers, staring impatiently at a barely-trickling hourglass beside a wall calendar (retimed slow).

scenes.onscreen_text: The moment your accounts arrive, we get moving.
scenes.voiceover: The moment your accounts arrive, our team gets moving.
scenes.visual: Victor clicks Send; glowing documents whoosh like comets into a giant email envelope, tie blown back.

scenes.voiceover: We start working your accounts the day you send them. Just email info@swrecovery.com.
scenes.visual: Holographic stopwatch flashes SAME DAY; green progress bar completes with a checkmark; Victor thumbs-up with mug.

scenes.onscreen_text: Getting your accounts to SWRS is easier than you think. / Email your placements to info@swrecovery.com
scenes.visual: Navy SWRS-color end card with the official white SWRS logo held top-center.
